desc:
🌊 DON'T SPLASH FREDBEAR😱

🚨 Welcome to DON'T SPLASH FREDBEAR!

A terrifying water nightmare begins... Your mission is simple: make your way through multiple rooms filled with dangerous traps and obstacles without falling into the water! 💀

But be careful... Freddy is lurking nearby, and he won't let you escape so easily! 👀

🏃‍♂️ Run, jump and dodge obstacles to reach the exit of each room.
🌊 Whatever you do, DON'T FALL INTO THE WATER!
😈 Survive deadly traps and unexpected surprises.
🚪 Complete every room and try to escape!

Do you have what it takes to survive until the end?

⚠️ One wrong move... and SPLASH!

🔥 PLAY DON'T SPLASH FREDBEAR... IF YOU DARE!
